sources.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B brings these advances to a compact, deployment-friendly dense model: a native vision-language model that understands images and videos, with flexible thinking control, designed to carry complex, multi-step tasks through to completion with greater reliability.

sources.title: Run Qwen 3.8 27B on AMD Ryzen™ AI Max Agentic PCs and Radeon ™ GPUs
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 27B arrives with Day 0 support on AMD Ryzen™ AI processors and Radeon™ graphics cards. Run the latest Qwen model locally with LM Studio on supported AMD hardware. Build and ship local AI applications with Lemonade and first-class AMD inference support.

sources.title: Qwen 3.8 27B: Specs, Hardware Requirements, and How to Run It (2026)
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B is out: Apache 2.0, a surprise vision encoder, 262k context, and published benchmarks. The confirmed specs, the GPU memory math, and how to serve it with vLLM or SGLang.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B - SGLang Documentation
sources.snippet: Deploy Qwen3.8-27B with SGLang — dense hybrid GDN vision-language model with BF16/FP8/NVFP4 W4A4 checkpoints and in-checkpoint MTP, single-GPU on H200, RTX PRO 6000, RTX 5090 and DGX Spark.

sources.title: Qwen3.8 - lmstudio.ai
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B is a dense 27B vision-language model for coding, professional work, research, and long-horizon agentic tasks, with configurable reasoning and a native 262K-token context window.
